beginner.title: Get started with TestLink
beginner.outcome: You can: set up TestLink, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Create and work cases
beginner.outcome: You can: log and resolve tickets or test cases
beginner.practice: Log and resolve three sample items

beginner.title: Knowledge and templates
beginner.outcome: You can: reuse answers and test steps
beginner.practice: Write two knowledge articles or reusable test steps

intermediate.title: Workflows and SLAs
intermediate.practice: Add an SLA and an escalation rule

intermediate.title: Reporting
intermediate.outcome: You can: report status and quality

intermediate.title: Signature skills in TestLink
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make TestLink distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced TestLink
expert.outcome: You can: use TestLink's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Integrate and govern
expert.outcome: You can: connect TestLink to the rest of the stack
expert.practice: Integrate TestLink with your issue tracker or CI

expert.title: Integrate TestLink into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect TestLink with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect TestLink to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use TestLink well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use TestLink" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
